intent: Compare the reported shares of raid proceeds allocated to investors, port fees, and the remaining bounty category.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Compare the reported shares of raid proceeds allocated to investors, port fees, and the remaining bounty category.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: Within the raid proceeds composition, the remaining bounty category is the largest reported share (50%), followed by investors (30%), then port fees (10%).
units.computation: order r3 > r1 > r2 by relative_value
accept: Bounties/rest is shown as the largest share, investors second, port fees smallest
The three named parts are compared in the order 50% > 30% > 10%
reject: Only one or two of the three named shares are shown without comparison
Shares are added together or treated as separate wholes
A different ordering is presented as the reported comparison

optional_valid: Showing each named sector's printed percentage label (30%, 10%, REST/50%) as supporting detail
Noting that the bounty/rest value is estimated rather than printed
unsupported_to_avoid: Deriving an unlabeled complement as a new category
Treating the 50% REST as an inferred remainder rather than a reported bounty category
Comparing across panels, rings, or countries (none exist)
Reporting an absolute count or gauge value
Describing colors, layout, or chart type as analytical content
review_notes: The intent asks for comparison of three named shares, so a single composition_order unit captures the required analytical fact without enumerating every sector separately.
Row r3 is labeled REST but the intent names it as the remaining bounty category; its 50% is treated as a reported/estimated share, not an inferred complement.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
